limitations: One host and six mirrored blocks are discovery evidence, not activation qualification.
All adverse settings remain; no automatic finalist selection or aggregate allowance is introduced.
Construction/admission/reuse, original route commitments and action iterations are retained separately; construction alone does not prove use or causal waste.
Phase timings overlap and do not isolate causal kernel costs; diagnostics never replace scored observations.
Process observations are sampled; inner snapshot gaps are descriptive and the frozen monitor checks enclosing cadence.
